proposal.summary: Current research cycle focused on memory-based preference formation (proj-mem-pref-01) and moral agency (proj-resp-form-01). Existing retrieved evidence (e.g., source-ef971ce280a64c52, source-7ca6e6512d38420a) currently lacks the substantive depth required to establish strong, evidence-backed claims regarding path-dependent preference development or moral agency in autonomous systems. Research is directed toward obtaining higher-quality, full-text scholarly material to address these specific gaps.
